## Evidence

- Screenshots or user-flow evidence, using fictional data:

## Security and governance

- [ ] No credentials, sessions, private paths, real job/application records, or
      other personal data were added.
- [ ] Dependency, SBOM, publication, provenance, and release-gate impact was
      assessed.
- [ ] ADR, threat-model delta, risk record, finding, and framework evidence delta
      were added or marked not applicable with rationale.
- [ ] Changelog, release notes, operations, migration, and rollback docs were
      updated when applicable.
- [ ] Public assurance wording is limited to executed evidence.

## Independent review and decision

- Reviewer and reviewed commit:
- Findings and disposition:
- Technical verdict: PASS / BLOCKED / NOT A RELEASE CANDIDATE
- Owner decisions required:
- Exact next action:

Merging, tagging, releasing, publishing, and accepting residual risk remain
separate Owner-controlled decisions.
